description:
The 26 Evo frameset is used on our Giro 26 Evo and Corsa Evo bikes. It includes a headset, seat struts/clamps, seat/frame clamp, idler system, 3-piece riser system, rear axle and tweener bar. So grab your favorite set of 26” or 700c wheels and components and build yourself your dream recumbent!
Frameset is disk brake only using a flat mount attachment. The Adroit2 dropouts allow for easy conversion between 142mm thru axle (12mm) and 135mm QR. The carbon fiber fork uses a 100mm thru axle and a flat mount brake attachment. The frameset does not include brake adapters as you will need ones that match the kind of brake and size of rotor you are using. A flat-mount rear brake can be used with a 140mm rotor without an adapter. Other brake adapters can be found here.
Rear tire clearance is 700c x 50mm. The fork, if ordered, also had clearance for up to 700c x 50mm tires. Note with a medium frame, the front clearance is 42mm.
The Evo frames now feature an internal gusset, increasing the weight limit to 275 lbs.
Weight of frame and seat clamp - 5 pounds, 10 oz (medium), 6 pounds, 1 oz (large)
Weight of idler assembly - 9.5 oz
Weight of 3-Piece riser system and lower riser clamp - 12.5 oz
Weight of handlebar - 11.2 oz
Weight of seat struts/clamps - 8 oz
